name: Ninja
listed_description: Small build system meant as a faster alternative to Make; the book drives it through CMake-generated build.ninja files rather than hand-written scripts.
claim_text: A faster alternative to Make; it gets high performance by dropping Make features such as string manipulation, loops and pattern matching.
book_benchmark: No measurement. The book only builds a tiny example project with cmake -GNinja and GCC 7.4.0 and states the speed claim qualitatively.
found_in: book: Extreme C (2019), ch. 23 Building and Compilation, section Ninja

name: Bazel
listed_description: Google's build system for multi-language projects (C, C++, Java, Go, Objective-C, Android, iOS), described as fast, scalable and parallel; book builds the example C project with bazel build //...
claim_text: Developed at Google for a fast and scalable build system; famous for parallel and scalable builds that make a difference in big projects.
book_benchmark: No measurement. The book shows a small example build with WORKSPACE and BUILD files and only notes that Make and Ninja can also build in parallel with -j.
found_in: book: Extreme C (2019), ch. 23 Building and Compilation, section Bazel
